title: The Real Reason You Doubt Decisions Immediately After Making Them
hook: Ever regret a choice the moment you make it?

narration.text: Ever regret a choice the moment you make it?
This feeling is called post-decision regret.
It happens because your brain suddenly focuses on the path not taken.
You start imagining how the alternative choices might have played out.
This quick shift can make your original decision seem less appealing.
It is a normal part of how we process choices.
Recognising this can help you not overthink those initial doubts.
Do you often feel this immediate regret after deciding something?

description: Discover why you sometimes doubt a decision immediately after making it. This common psychological phenomenon, known as post-decision regret, is a fascinating part of how our brains process choices.
topic: Why you sometimes doubt a decision immediately after making it, known as post-decision regret.
